pet_notes: Humanoid chibi swordsman: straight layered black shoulder-length hair; viewer-left eye golden yellow and viewer-right eye teal-green in front view; white cloth bandages cover mouth and lower face; black-and-white vertically striped haori over a dark navy uniform with gold buttons and a white belt; white calf bandages and dark indigo sandals; one small white snake with red eyes stays physically wrapped around the neck and shoulders, never detached. No sword, parasol, tablet, scenery, text, watermark, or extra snake.
